deploy-bot: [2141594321] Deploy started: parallel launch for services runtime, api, console -> prod-us-west-2. Commits/tags: runtime@v3.2.0-rc4, api@a1b2c3d, console@release/2026-03-18. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary: 10% for api/runtime. :rocket:

sam: Ack, watching the rollout.

jess: noted, expected durations runtime ~7m, api ~2m, console ~3m.

deploy-bot: [2141594385] console: SUCCEEDED — rollout complete in 2m13s — tag release/2026-03-18. :tada:

anya: console metrics look good from the dashboard. No error bump.

deploy-bot: [2141594440] api: PARTIAL — canary healthy overall but 2 instances returned 500s upstream; rollout paused automatically (failure_threshold=0.05).

liam: seeing the 500s in api; looks like auth upstream timeout + token errors.

sam: Pausing api rollout and preparing to pin to previous stable tag (api@a1b2c3d-prev).

jess: Can the system auto-rollback or do we need manual?

deploy-bot: [2141594500] api: ROLLBACK INITIATED -> target tag api@a1b2c3d-prev (automatic fallback due to threshold breach).

ops-bot: Notifying oncall -> @pagerduty_eng (incident channel).

liam: I'll open a debug session on the failing host group and collect traces.

sam: Any impact on runtime? Is it still rolling?

deploy-bot: [2141594530] runtime: STRAGGLER — 1/20 instances failed to start on gpu-pool-3 due to driver mismatch (required 535.xx, found 520.xx). 19/20 healthy.

anya: That node was supposed to be patched last week. Ugh.

liam: I'll evacuate containers from that host and reprovision driver; ETA ~18m.

jess: Recommend holding the runtime rollout to avoid cascading failures. Suggest pin runtime to runtime@v3.2.0-rc3 until pool repaired.

sam: Agreed. Pinning runtime now.

deploy-bot: [2141594600] runtime: ROLLED BACK to runtime@v3.2.0-rc3 (pin applied). Rollback reason: infra node driver mismatch.

deploy-bot: [2141594700] Deploy summary: console SUCCEEDED, api ROLLED BACK to previous tag, runtime ROLLED BACK due to infra straggler. Change window remains open; recommended reattempt after infra patch. Changelog: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/2026-03-18 , Runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/deploy-rollback

sam: I'll annotate the release notes: add preflight driver verification and explicit node pool healthcheck.

liam: Coordinating with infra to patch gpu-pool-3 and verify image boots. Will post progress.

jess: Pinged PMs: @emma — rollback done, will reattempt after infra fix and verification.

deploy-bot: [2141598400] followup: reattempt scheduled at 2141600400 (in ~50m) unless manually aborted. Change window extended by 30m.

anya: Thanks all — keeping monitoring on. If infra confirms patch earlier we can accelerate reattempt.

sam: I'll follow up on the runbook updates and ensure release notes reflect the rollback and pin decisions.

liam: backup note: collected driver logs + node reprovision steps in the infra ticket.

deploy-bot: End of thread.
